testContract: No countertop wood or continuous structural ridge may appear above the front fascia in any frame.
Any legitimate appliance pixel in the former rear zone must stay inside that unit's declared appliance interval.
The full-width eight-pixel front fascia remains opaque and byte-equal to the Option-B fascia template.
Only the sink basin may occlude the fascia, and only inside x 23 through 61 inclusive.
V13 is a required failing control for the no-rear-ridge test.
The test runs from npm test across standard, on and broken states frame by frame.
